description: F105.2 (cardmem-F401.1) — keep Docker base images pinned and fresh. A repo opts in with: "extends": ["github>broberg-ai/components//renovate/image-hygiene"]

packageRules.description: Pin every Docker base image to a digest, so a rebuild cannot silently pick up a different image.
Digest refreshes and digest pinning of base images: automerge, but ONLY through a PR whose own checks are green (Renovate never merges a red PR; ignoreTests is never set).
Patch, minor and major base-image updates are a decision: PR only, never automerged.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes: PR immediately (outside the night window), automerged only when the repo's checks are green.
